evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Across three browser-use benchmarks, P2A shows clear gains on task success rate for both proprietary and fine-tuned models; on VisualWebArena, for example, it improves Gemini-3-Pro from 54.1% to 61.2% and Qwen3-VL-8B from 24.6% to 32.9%, while matching the costly full-observation history ($\sim$3$\times$) at only $\sim$1.2$\times$ the peak retained input context of action-only history.
